_about: Where push_review_bundle.py puts a session's .tif under CNMFE_FORCNMFE_ROOT (X:/Jeremy/for CNMFe). Key = area/task of the local session; value = {animal: folder}, '*' = any other animal. Folders are relative to the root and must already exist (the push never creates one). An unmapped session is pushed without a tif copy, and the push says so.
_source: 2026-11-25: every entry is where that area/task/animal's tifs already sat on the server (read-only walk, matched by exact session name), except vCA1/3odor cohort 5 (pnb99/102/104/105/106/109 -> cohort5, the user's choice; only pnb99 and pnb102 were there).
